mapping.summary: Reusable header and footer text blocks for sales, purchase and service documents.
claims: Central library of reusable intro and closing texts for documents
Language variants chosen by document language with a fallback text
Auto-assigns texts by area, usage, validity period and conditions like customer, country or currency
Placeholders pull in document, customer, vendor, contact and company data
Supports bold, italic, underline and font colours per text block
Texts for follow-on documents can be prepared on the order
Texts on posted and archived documents stay read-only
Covers quotes, orders, purchase orders, shipments, invoices, credit memos and service documents
Ships adapted Word and RDLC layouts for supported standard reports
Requires BC Online version 28 or later
